title: Collinear matching for leading power gluon transverse momentum distributions
summary: We compute the tree-level and one-loop matching relations for leading power gluon transverse momentum dependent parton distribution functions. At tree level, working within the spinor formalism, we focus on twist-2 and twist-3 contributions, deriving the complete series of mass corrections for both T-even and T-odd distributions. At one-loop accuracy, we extend the parton-in-parton framework to include contributions beyond the leading term in the small-b expansion.
